title: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 Review | Marina Barrage
meta_description: Garmin Run Singapore review: 6,000 runners at Marina Barrage on 12 October 2025, and how the organisers fixed the queues that marred the 2024 debut.
dek: Garmin's Singapore race drew 6,000 runners to Marina Barrage in October 2025, a year after a debut criticised for long queues. Here is what the second edition was like.
verdict: Garmin Run Singapore had something to prove in 2025. Its first edition, in 2024, was criticised for long queues at bag drop and race pack collection [1]. The second, on 12 October 2025, drew more than 6,000 runners to Marina Barrage for a half marathon and a 10 km, up from 5,000 [1], and SportPlus reported that check-in, bag drop, hydration points and volunteers were all much improved [1]. If you want a half marathon along Singapore's Marina Bay with a manageable field, it is now a solid choice. The only account available is one publication's, and it is enthusiastic.

sections.heading: From a Rocky Debut to the 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The inaugural Garmin Run Singapore in 2024 drew criticism for long queues at bag drop and race pack collection [1]. The 2025 edition, on Sunday 12 October, was the organisers' chance to fix that.
SportPlus reported streamlined check-in, efficient bag drop, well-marked hydration points and cheerful volunteers, and called it one of the best-run endurance events in Singapore that year [1].

sections.heading: The Race
paragraphs: More than 6,000 runners gathered at Marina Barrage at dawn, up from 5,000 the year before [1]. There were two categories: the 21.1 km half marathon and a 10 km competitive run [1].
The race village at Marina Barrage had recovery zones, hydration booths and live entertainment [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon or 10 km in central Singapore with a field of about 6,000, yes. The 2025 edition suggests the organisers learned from their first year.

Keep the source in mind. The account of 2025 comes from a single publication and reads warmly, so look for runners' reports too. And remember that October in Singapore can fall in the regional haze season.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran Garmin Run Singapore in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 6,000 runners took part on Sunday 12 October 2025 at Marina Barrage, up from about 5,000 at the first edition in 2024. There were two categories: the 21.1 km half marathon and a 10 km competitive run.

faqs.question: Did Garmin Run Singapore fix its 2024 problems?
faqs.answer: By SportPlus's account, yes. The 2024 debut was criticised for long queues at bag drop and race pack collection, and in 2025 the publication reported streamlined check-in, efficient bag drop and well-marked hydration points.

faqs.question: Where is Garmin Run Singapore held?
faqs.answer: At Marina Barrage, by Marina Bay in central Singapore. In 2025 the race started at dawn and the race village had recovery zones, hydration booths and live entertainment.
